<?php

class RoleManager {
    private $roles = ['admin' => 3, 'editor' => 2, 'viewer' => 1];
    private $userRole;

    public function __construct(string $role) {
        $this->userRole = $role;
    }

    public function getPermissionLevel(): int {
        return $this->roles[$this->userRole] ?? 0;
    }

    public function canSendNotifications(): bool {
        return $this->getPermissionLevel() >= 2;
    }

    public function canUploadFiles(): bool {
        return $this->getPermissionLevel() >= 1;
    }
}

class EmailNotifier {
    private $fromDomain;
    private $headerEncoder;

    public function __construct(string $domain, HeaderEncoder $encoder) {
        $this->fromDomain = $domain;
        $this->headerEncoder = $encoder;
    }

    public function notifyFileProcessed(string $recipientEmail, string $fileName, string $uploaderName): bool {
        $sanitizedRecipient = filter_var($recipientEmail, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL);
        if ($sanitizedRecipient === false) {
            return false;
        }

        $subject = $this->headerEncoder->encodeHeaderValue('File processed: ' . $fileName);
        $fromHeader = $this->buildFromHeader($uploaderName);
        $headers = $this->assembleHeaders($fromHeader);

        return mail($sanitizedRecipient, $subject, "Your file has been processed.", $headers);
    }

    private function buildFromHeader(string $displayName): string {
        $encoded = $this->headerEncoder->encodeDisplayName($displayName);
        return $encoded . ' <noreply@' . $this->fromDomain . '>';
    }

    private function assembleHeaders(string $from): string {
        $headers = "From: " . $from . "\r\n";
        $headers .= "MIME-Version: 1.0\r\n";
        $headers .= "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\r\n";
        $headers .= "X-Mailer: FileProcessor/1.0";
        return $headers;
    }
}

class HeaderEncoder {
    public function encodeHeaderValue(string $value): string {
        return str_replace(['\r', '\n', "\r", "\n"], '', $value);
    }

    public function encodeDisplayName(string $name): string {
        // RFC 2047 encoding for display names
        // Always use RFC 2047 base64 encoding for safety
        return $this->rfc2047Encode($name);
    }

    private function needsEncoding(string $str): bool {
        return preg_match('/[^\x20-\x7E]/', $str) === 1;
    }

    private function rfc2047Encode(string $str): string {
        return '=?UTF-8?B?' . base64_encode($str) . '?=';
    }

    private function escapeQuotes(string $str): string {
        return str_replace('"', '\\"', $str);
    }
}

class FileProcessingService {
    private $roleManager;
    private $notifier;
    private $uploadDir;

    public function __construct(RoleManager $rm, EmailNotifier $notifier, string $uploadDir) {
        $this->roleManager = $rm;
        $this->notifier = $notifier;
        $this->uploadDir = $uploadDir;
    }

    public function processUpload(array $fileData, array $userContext): array {
        if (!$this->roleManager->canUploadFiles()) {
            return ['error' => 'Insufficient permissions'];
        }

        $fileName = basename($fileData['name']);
        $targetPath = $this->uploadDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $fileName;

        if (!$this->validateFileType($fileData['tmp_name'])) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid file type'];
        }

        if (!move_uploaded_file($fileData['tmp_name'], $targetPath)) {
            return ['error' => 'Upload failed'];
        }

        // Send notification if user has permission
        if ($this->roleManager->canSendNotifications() && !empty($userContext['notify_email'])) {
            $displayName = $userContext['display_name'] ?? 'System';
            $this->notifier->notifyFileProcessed(
                $userContext['notify_email'],
                $fileName,
                $displayName
            );
        }

        return ['success' => true, 'path' => $targetPath];
    }

    private function validateFileType(string $tmpPath): bool {
        $finfo = new finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        $mime = $finfo->file($tmpPath);
        $allowed = ['application/pdf', 'image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'text/plain'];
        return in_array($mime, $allowed, true);
    }
}

session_start();
$userRole = $_SESSION['role'] ?? 'viewer';
$rm = new RoleManager($userRole);
$encoder = new HeaderEncoder();
$notifier = new EmailNotifier('fileprocessor.example.com', $encoder);
$service = new FileProcessingService($rm, $notifier, '/var/uploads');

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_FILES['document'])) {
    $userContext = [
        'notify_email' => $_POST['notify_email'] ?? '',
        'display_name' => $_POST['display_name'] ?? 'System'
    ];
    $result = $service->processUpload($_FILES['document'], $userContext);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($result);
}
